jobs.title: Index Analyst Intern (Summer 2027)
jobs.description_text: About Syntax Data Syntax LLC is a financial data and technology company that codifies business models into a relational system we call Affinity Data™. Syntax operates through three segments: Affinity Data™, Syntax Direct™, and Syntax Indices™. Using its patented FIS® technology inspired by systems sciences, the Affinity Data™ segment offers comprehensive, granular product-line revenue data. Syntax Direct™ uses this data to facilitate the creation and ongoing management of direct indexing solutions and rules-based equity portfolios through an automated platform. Syntax Indices™ offers customized and proprietary indices, including core global benchmarks, thematic, smart beta, defined outcome, and target volatility indices. These indices serve as the foundation for a range of financial products, including ETFs, UITs, and structured products. About the Role The Index Intern will support our team by assisting with the research, creation, and development of market indices.

jobs.title: Lead Mil-Ka Senior System Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Within the System Engineering team, lead the technical coordination needed to adapt Lightspeed’s low Earth orbit constellation and associated ground infrastructure for military Ka-band communications supporting the Enhanced Satellite Communications Project - Polar (ESCP-P) and other defence customers. This is a senior individual-contributor role in which you will lead technical work across all Lightspeed teams without managing staff. You will build on established designs, analyses, and test plans, focusing additional analysis where decisions require it. ESCP-P is intended to meet Government of Canada requirements by providing the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) with secure, resilient, high-speed communications for operations at home and abroad, particularly in Arctic and other high-latitude regions. The project supports Canada’s Arctic sovereignty and continental defence, including interoperability with the North Atlantic Treaty Organization (NATO) and North American Aerospace Defense Command (NORAD).

The role is primarily oriented toward instructional design, content development, and learner experience. Working with Sales Operations, subject matter experts, and cross-functional partners, the Specialist creates clear, engaging, and scalable learning experiences that support employee success. These solutions help employees confidently adopt and apply Sales Operations systems, capabilities, and business processes, improving adoption, knowledge retention, and performance. The ideal candidate brings 3-5 years of relevant experience, strong instructional design and content-development capabilities, and the ability to independently own work from concept through delivery. AI, automation, and emerging technologies are expected to be integral to how the role develops content, improves workflows, and increases operational efficiency.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive, Mexico & Central America
jobs.description_text: Telesat (Nasdaq and TSX: TSAT) is a leading global satellite operator, providing reliable and secure satellite-delivered communications solutions worldwide to broadcast, telecommunications, corporate and government customers for over 55 years. Backed by a legacy of engineering excellence, reliability and industry-leading customer service, Telesat has grown to be one of the largest and most successful global satellite operators. Telesat Lightspeed, our revolutionary Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite network, scheduled to begin service in 2027, will revolutionize global broadband connectivity for enterprise and Government users by delivering a combination of high capacity, security, resiliency and affordability with ultra-low latency and fiber-like speeds. Telesat is headquartered in Ottawa, Canada, and has offices and facilities around the world. The company’s state-of-the-art Satellite fleet consists of 12 GEO satellites, the Canadian payload on ViaSat-1 and one LEO 3 demonstration satellite. For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com

jobs.title: Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist
jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com Are you passionate about breakthrough technologies and eager to shape the future of satellite-based solutions for defence and national security? We are seeking a Senior Defence Systems Engineering Specialist to help shape new satellite-enabled capabilities for Canadian and allied defence users. Reporting to the Director, Research & Development, Defence Satellite Mission Solutions, you will lead multidisciplinary investigations from mission-need qualification through initial prototype laboratory validation. Initial opportunities include system features such as alternative positioning, navigation and timing (PNT), optical relay connectivity with other satellite systems, and space-domain awareness data products. You will combine technical depth with systems thinking, practical experimentation and multidisciplinary leadership.

jobs.department: Lightspeed System Development - Landing Stations and User Terminals
jobs.description_text: The Senior Program Manager – Ground System Modem leads end-to-end delivery of the modem within a complex SATCOM ground-system solution. This role is accountable for integrated planning, supplier execution, cross-functional and technical alignment, acceptance, deployment, and operational readiness. Combining strong program leadership with telecommunications/SATCOM knowledge, the Senior Program Manager works across engineering, System Architecture, Product Owners, Integration and Test, program controls, Procurement, Operations, and external suppliers to manage dependencies, risks, commitments, and critical decisions. The role may establish a new program or take ownership of an in-flight delivery, quickly building a fact-based view of status, priorities, critical path, supplier commitments, and recovery needs. Success requires strong supplier and stakeholder leadership, commercial and contractual awareness, and a delivery-focused approach that drives issues and decisions to closure.

jobs.description_text: For more information, follow Telesat on X and LinkedIn or visit www.telesat.com The incumbent is responsible for securing, maintaining, and protecting the spectrum and orbital rights required to support Telesat's GSO and NGSO satellite systems. The role leads complex spectrum engineering, ITU filing and coordination activities; conducts interference and compatibility analyses; supports satellite system design from a spectrum and regulatory perspective; and represents Telesat in technical coordination discussions with satellite operators, administrations, and relevant domestic and international regulatory bodies. The position provides technical and regulatory advice that informs satellite system design, spectrum strategy, and regulatory decisions.

jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a motivated Associate Director, Capital Markets Finance, preferably with a background in investment banking or equity research, to help build on and execute our capital markets strategy. Reporting to the CFO, this role will support existing relationships with analysts and investors, while also serving as a trusted resource to senior leadership on how Wall Street views our strategy, pipeline, and financial performance. The successful candidate thrives at the intersection of finance, science, and storytelling, translating complex clinical and operational data into compelling investor-ready narratives that resonate with institutional investors and analysts.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Marketing
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo’s Commercial team is building the strategy, insights, brand and infrastructure required to bring LX2006 to patients – marking Lexeo’s transition from a clinical-stage to a commercial company. We are seeking an Associate Director, Marketing to play a central role in preparing for the launch of LX2006, Lexeo’s first commercial product, anticipated in the US in 2028 and globally thereafter. Reporting to the Senior Director, Marketing, this individual will serve as the LX2006 brand lead, owning critical launch workstreams end to end – from customer insights and competitive intelligence to market development, campaigns, customer targeting and launch readiness – and working closely with cross-functional partners in Market Access/HEOR, Medical Affairs, Patient Affairs, Clinical Development, Regulatory, Legal, CMC, and Business Development (ad hoc) as part of Lexeo’s Launch Readiness Team. The role will also support early commercial planning for LX2020, Lexeo’s gene therapy candidate for PKP2-associated arrhythmogenic cardiomyopathy. This is a highly visible, hands-on opportunity to build a launch from the ground up and help shape the commercial foundation of a growing clinical stage company. We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, In Vivo Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is seeking a hands-on in vivo pharmacologist to build rodent models of cardiac disease and use them to de-risk targets, screen therapeutic candidates and advance our discovery pipeline. The scientist will design, perform or manage rodent studies from target validation through hit identification, working cross-functionally with In Vitro Pharmacology, Modality Engineering, and Translational Sciences to select-advance molecules. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist I/II, Modality Engineering
jobs.description_text: Role Summary Lexeo is hiring a hands-on Modality Engineering Scientist to design, synthesize, and characterize oligonucleotides, bioconjugates, and AAV therapeutics for our discovery pipeline. The scientist will advance molecules from design through analytical characterization and handoff to in vitro and in vivo teams, working across chemistry, molecular biology, and pharmacology. Reporting to the Head of Cardiac Research, this role joins cardiac, neuroscience, and non-clinical scientists developing therapies for genetic heart disease and offers broad experience in multidisciplinary biopharma research.

jobs.title: Scientist II, Cellular Neuroscience and Translational Pharmacology
jobs.description_text: Role Summary We are seeking a highly collaborative, hands-on Scientist II to help establish a preclinical neuroscience laboratory supporting small-molecule and protein therapeutics. The immediate priorities are rapid cellular profiling and lead selection for an advanced small-molecule enzyme program, and leadership of cellular development for a transferrin-based protein replacement project. The role will also build fit-for-purpose human neuronal models, laboratory workflows, and external partnerships. Location We welcome applications from candidates located across the Northeast and Mid-Atlantic.

jobs.title: Solutions Architect
jobs.description_text: About the Role VGS is hiring a Solutions Architect in Europe to be the technical front door for our European prospects and customers. As part of our European and Support organization, you will bring your expertise to the earliest stage of the relationship: scoping use cases, mapping payment flows, and designing the solution with EU Sales. Once the client is onboarded, you will continue to provide ongoing technical support. Roughly three-quarters of your time will be spent on solution work, and the remainder will be spent on technical support. This is a growth role for a senior support, integration, or solutions engineer who wants to move upstream, and you will help shape how Solutions and Support work together in Europe. You will operate largely in the region alongside the EU team, while the US Solutions team is offline, with a few hours of overlap with the US team towards the end of your day. We are looking for a payments nerd who, in a single day, can earn a prospect CTO's trust, map a complex payment flow with an existing customer's payments leader, help a colleague in Sales through a technical conversation, and trace a failing integration with the customer's engineers. You will partner with payment companies and enterprise merchants on global payment infrastructure, processor connectivity, credential portability, tokenization, and sensitive payment data. jobs.description_text: To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai At the heart of our mission is an unwavering commitment to safety. Behavior Verification answers one question: is the driver's on-road behavior good enough to release, and how can we prove it even further? We are seeking a rigorous and decisive systems engineer to build the evidence behind that answer. You will define the scenario and test set content that various Software releases are measured against and that enable the development of new capabilities and features, establish the validity checks that keep those test sets trustworthy, and act as the gatekeeper for what enters the release pipeline. Your work directly informs whether autonomy software is promoted. You will… Design and document the scenario and test sets that establish on-road behavior performance, from minimum to comprehensive. Own what enters the release pipeline: define and run the scenario validity checks, and approve or refuse test sets before they are used to judge a release. Maintain continuous quality feedback of the artifacts test sets depend on — scenarios, taggers, graders and the taxonomy behind them. Turn behavior requirements into testable criteria, working with Behavior Requirements on targets and acceptance criteria that someone will sign. Investigate behavior deficiencies: find further instances, establish what exposure we have to them, and return them to the pipeline as test escapes. jobs.title: Senior QA Engineer Position for Xsolla's Smart Wallet in Web3
jobs.description_text: ABOUT YOU We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer who has tested real on-chain products — the contracts and the transactions, not only the web app in front of them. You will own quality for Xsolla's smart wallet on Xsolla ZK, our Ethereum-compatible ZK rollup: the wallet players use to hold, receive and send tokens and in-game items, signing in with the account they already have. The work runs on both sides of the chain. On the backend, you will confirm that a wallet address pre-computed from a salt is the address that actually gets deployed. On the frontend, you will follow a signed operation from the client's RPC call through the bundler to finality, and prove it landed, failed or reverted the way it should. You will fork the chain to test against real state, deploy and call contracts from the command line, and turn what you learn into automated suites. You will work in a small, senior engineering team alongside an external wallet-infrastructure partner. You can tell a defect in our code from one in a partner SDK or in the chain itself — and you bring the evidence to show which. AI coding tools are part of how you work every day, and you set them up so the rest of the team gets the same leverage.

jobs.title: Research Engineer, AI Monitoring
jobs.description_text: About the role Our team builds, tests, deploys, and monitors the classifiers that block internal agents from taking dangerous actions. These classifiers run across RL, evals, and internal deployments, and are designed to catch things like sandbox escape attempts or exfiltration of sensitive data. When a classifier flags an action, it can block the action before the tool call runs, end the task, and alert a human . This is one layer of a defence-in-depth with several layers that reinforce each other: what our classifiers flag feeds into offline monitoring, and the findings from that go back into better classifiers and safer environment design. The work combines research and production engineering: The research problem is building high recall and high precision classifiers to catch rare, novel, and sometimes adversarial behaviour. There are also several narrow research questions to answer - for example, how to deploy safety classifiers inside training environments without incentivising models to evade them. Some research also builds on the multi-stage designs described in our work on Claude Code auto mode and Constitutional Classifiers . The engineering problem is shipping these classifiers into the critical path of research and product work. These classifiers need to cover a huge volume of traffic while operating within cost, latency and availability constraints. Le projet Sound or Silent (SoS) vise à combler cette lacune en étudiant une nouvelle approche d’IA agentique correcte par construction. L’idée centrale consiste à intégrer le raisonnement stratégique et la vérification formelle directement au processus décisionnel des agents autonomes. Slow head: fine-tune an open frontier vision-language model to reason over fused sensor tokens instead of pictures. Inzetten van Azure-technologie: Je ontwerpt oplossingen met onder andere Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, API Management, Service Bus en Event Grid.

jobs.title: Embedded & Firmware QA Engineer
jobs.description_text: The Role You'll own the quality of the firmware and embedded systems across our physical product portfolio. That means making sure every firmware release is tested, reliable, and ready for the field, and that defects are caught before they reach a client. This is a senior, hands-on role. You understand electronics and embedded systems well enough to reproduce and diagnose issues yourself, read a schematic, and build your own test kits and jigs. You don't wait for an engineer to set things up for you. You run your area independently. Over the past year, we've built a validation framework that changed how we release firmware. We now ship on evidence instead of gut feel: structured test cycles across our product generations, tracked defects across release candidates, formal release reviews, and controlled rollouts to the fleet. Your first job is to own that framework and keep it strong. Your bigger job is to take it further. Today, testing mostly happens once a release is nearly done.
